EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into on 01 January 2027 between NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and Alex Kumar.

1. POSITION AND DUTIES
The Employee is hired as Senior Software Associate.

2. TERM AND DURATION
The term starts on 01 January 2027 and continues until 31 December 2027.

3. COMPENSATION
Gross salary is ₹60,000 per month payable on the last business day.

4. TERMINATION AND NOTICE
Either party may terminate this agreement with thirty (30) days prior written notice.

5. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration in Chennai under the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
